boundary: Wave 5 preserves Waves 1–4 and adds 100 distinct evidence-discovery passes. seeded_with_primary means at least one relevant primary/experimental anchor was found; it does not mean the topic is saturated. gap_seeded remains a deliberate gap, not padded completion.

status_semantics.seeded_with_primary: At least one relevant primary/experimental evidence anchor was identified for the pass; full-text scope and claim-bounding review remains required.
status_semantics.gap_seeded: The pass is preserved as an explicit gap because directly relevant primary measured evidence remains thin or indirect.
